notes.title: Berry Munch is one year old!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33034550/c590d72c253de5f61cac0923cfbc5483f8ffa4f5.png[/img]

A year has past since Berry Munch joined the colourful world of Steam games! To celebrate, we've reduced the price to half. Yes, that's a whooping [b]50% off[/b] - and it's here to stay! So, grab your copy and meet Berry Munch. He'll take you on an adventure of a lifetime! 

P.S. The challenges that await Berry might be a little harder than we originally advertised - We're still waiting for a brave soul to complete all the achievements... Are you that hero?
